$comment: THE FLOOR GATE baseline. Every artifact type here is one whose review resolves through NO renderer today and therefore lands on the card's metadata floor. The gate requires the LIVE floor set to equal this file exactly: a type that newly lands on the floor fails, and a type that stops landing on it fails until its entry is deleted. The committed set may only shrink against the base branch. cinatra#3319 acceptance 2 retired the host form rung the gate used to count as coverage — the host's own text and markdown viewers are gone, so a declared text form no installed pack provides for is what a reader would actually meet, and the gate now says so. The twelve text/plain entries below are the types that reading newly exposes; each names the upstream that retires it, and every one of them is already in flight. This file is SHRINK-ONLY: an entry may leave, none may join.
